locations.label: Sergei Ravenov
locations.description: Must be interacted with to start the main quest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Compound S16 - Truth Serum
locations.description: 1 of 3 compounds required as part of the truth serum in the main quest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Dart Board / Aetherium Converter
locations.description: Using a code found in the weapon lab PC, it can be shot in order (then the bullseye) to drop 1 of 3 parts used to create a free RAI K-84.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Boss Fight
locations.description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
Orda Fight, activates after freeing Maxis from the OPC.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Dimitri Kuhlklay
locations.description: Burnt body on the floor that must be interacted with in order to gain access to the PC in the weapons lab, to progress the free RAI K-84 quest. (Note: the blueprint in the weapon lab must be picked up before you can interact with the body.)
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Kuhlklay's Desk
locations.description:
Used in the free RAI K-84 side quest. There is a PC, which must be accessed using Kuhlklay's eye, found on a body in scorched defense, against a tank
Once activated it will display graphics of a dart board used to obtain a RAI K-84 part back in the spawn area. A drawer will also open, allowing you to pick up a key, used to unlock lockers in the barracks.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: RAI K-84 Barracks lockers
locations.description:
Lockers that will spawn Mimics when opened with the key obtained from the weapons lab
One of the mimics will drop the Barrel Stabiliser, 1 of 3 parts used to create a free RAI K-84.
locations.state: Possible location — confirm the active spawn in your match

locations.label: RAI K-84 Barracks lockers
locations.description:
Lockers that will spawn Mimics when opened with the key obtained from the weapons lab
One of the mimics will drop the Barrel Stabiliser, 1 of 3 parts used to create a free RAI K-84.
locations.state: Possible location — confirm the active spawn in your match

locations.label: Computer
locations.description: Used as a charging station to charge up the Overcharged Power Cell that is 1 of the 3 parts in the RAI K-84 side quest. You may need to wait a couple of rounds after placing the magazine in order to fully charge it.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Dr William Peck
locations.description: Interact with after activating power across the map, then head back to Ravenov to acquire his ID card.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Compound P65 - Truth Serum
locations.description: 1 of 3 compounds required as part of the truth serum in the main quest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Compound 36 - Truth Serum
locations.description: 1 of 3 compounds required as part of the truth serum in the main quest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Chemical Mixer
locations.description: Found in the field hospital, can be interacted with after obtaining all 3 compounds to drop the "Agent Delivery System" which will need to be placed on the air conditioning unit of Dr Peck's shelter.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Dr Peck's Air Conditioner
locations.description: Used with the "Agent Delivery System" to deliver the truth serum to Dr Peck. Interact with him afterwards to progress the quest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Memory Transference Station
locations.description:
Unlocked after drugging Dr Peck with truth serum. Provides essence traps that are used to catch mimics
You can bring the captured mimics back in order to get some dialog from different characters containing codes, the ones we need for the quest are Sokolov, Brahms and Zabim. Once all 3 codes are obtained, the machine will spit out a floppy disk.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Quantum Main Frame
locations.description: Can be interacted with after obtaining the floppy disk from the mimic step. Opens an anomaly in the large spherical chamber outside the window in front of you.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: OPC (Omega Portal Chamber)
locations.description: Used as part of the main quest, after the mimic step, will open an anomaly and later after the satellite alignment step be must be interacted with in order to teleport to the boss fight.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Aethermeter
locations.description: Drops from a locker next to Dr Peck's shelter after unlocking the Quantum Main Frame and talking to Peck who provides the code.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Shovel
locations.description: Required to dig up Containers after acquiring the Aethermeter.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Aether Crystal 1 of 3
locations.description: Can be dug up after acquiring the Shovel and Aethermeter. Triggers a lockdown event that will trap you in a yellow bubble, charging the crystal. Once complete, it can be picked up.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Aether Crystal 1 of 3
locations.description: Can be dug up after acquiring the Shovel and Aethermeter. Spawns lots of identical containers in the vicinity, to progress you need to pick up the container that ONLY has a crystal and WHITE smoke. Any black smoke inside a container indicates it is the wrong one.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Aether Crystal 1 of 3
locations.description: Barracks / Field Hospital dig start. After digging, the crystal teleports within the nearby area; this is not its guaranteed final position.
locations.state: Possible location — confirm the active spawn in your match

locations.label: Computer
locations.description: Used after placing all 3 Crystals in the reactors. Will display a world map to realign a satellite, each will have a flag in the bottom right corner. When you see a location with a question mark, align with that one to activate the OPC and allow you to begin the boss fight.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Cassette Tape
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song
Up the stairs on the book shelf.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Cassette Tape
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song
Inside a pigeon hole next to the locker containing one of the compounds for the main quest.
locations.state: Possible location — confirm the active spawn in your match

locations.label: Mr Peeks Jumpscare
locations.description: Stare at the bunny in outside of the map bounds in order to be teleported to the Dark Aether and obtain a bonus chest.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state

locations.label: Cassette Tape
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song
On the floor resting against a filing cabinet in the motor pool office.
locations.state: Requires the relevant quest, world tier or game state
